app.name: Spotify
app.description: A digital music, podcast, and video streaming service that provides access to millions of songs and other content from creators worldwide.

notes: Composio does not provide a default OAuth app for Spotify; you must create your own in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
No extra custom connection fields are required beyond standard Client ID and Client Secret.

assumption: An agent that reads, plays, and manages playlists in any user's Spotify account via Composio.

verdict.headline: Spotify requires strict business verification and a minimum of 250,000 Monthly Active Users to unlock production access for arbitrary users.
verdict.summary: You can register an app instantly in self-serve mode, but it is capped at 5 allowlisted test users. Unlocking production (Extended Quota Mode) requires an established corporate entity and meeting high volume thresholds. Consequently, indie developers and early-stage agents are heavily restricted.

handsOnEffort.label: 1–2 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Dashboard app registration and redirect URI configuration takes minutes, but form submission adds setup friction.

timeToFirstConnection.label: Instant
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Self-serve development mode is available immediately upon account creation.

timeToProduction.label: 6+ weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Spotify states extended quota reviews take up to 6 weeks, and eligibility requires an established business with 250k+ MAU.

verdict.longestPole: Meeting Spotify's strict eligibility criteria (250k+ MAU organization requirement) and waiting up to 6 weeks for review.
verdict.costDetail: Spotify Developer Dashboard and API access are free, though user accounts require Spotify Premium for specific playback capabilities.

easierPaths.condition: Limit app usage to 5 or fewer internal test users
easierPaths.effect: Stays in Development Mode immediately without needing any formal business review.

factors.detail: Developers can create up to 25 apps instantly in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Transitioning from Development Mode to Extended Quota Mode for arbitrary users requires manual review.
Spotify requires an established organization (not individuals) operating an active launched service.
No explicit technical security audit or penetration test certificate is listed as a prerequisite.
API access does not require a paid developer tier subscription.
Extended quota requires strict commercial viability and hitting an aggressive 250k MAU threshold.
Development Mode restricts connections to a maximum of 5 explicitly allowlisted users.
Setup is handled globally via the developer dashboard and Composio rather than per individual end-user organization tenant.

phases.title: Register your Spotify Developer App
phases.outcome: You have a Client ID and Client Secret in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

steps.title: Create a Spotify Developer Account and App
steps.details: Log in to the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Click **Create an App**, enter your app name and description, accept the Terms of Service, and click **CREATE**.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can help draft the app name and description based on your product specs.

phases.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
phases.outcome: Your app recognizes the Composio callback endpoint and requests correct permissions.

steps.title: Add the Composio Redirect URI
steps.details: In your app settings within the **Spotify Developer Dashboard**, navigate to **Settings**, locate the **Redirect URIs** field, enter `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`, and click **Add**.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can remind you of the exact redirect URL string to paste.

phases.title: Test in Development Mode
phases.outcome: You can connect and test your Spotify integration using explicitly allowlisted accounts.

steps.title: Allowlist Test User Emails
steps.details: In the **Spotify Developer Dashboard**, open your app and go to **Users and Access**. Add up to 5 individual user email addresses (including your Spotify Premium account email) so they can authenticate during development.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can generate an audit checklist of test account emails you need to whitelist.

phases.title: Apply for Extended Quota Mode (Production)
phases.outcome: Your application for production access is submitted to Spotify.

steps.title: Submit Extended Quota Application
steps.details: Ensure your organization meets the requirement of operating an active launched service with at least 250,000 Monthly Active Users (MAUs). Submit your application via the dedicated Google Form using a company email, and complete the follow-up questionnaire in the dashboard.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can help draft your questionnaire responses detailing your app architecture and use case.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Your Spotify custom auth integration is fully operational inside Composio.

steps.title: Create Custom Auth Configuration in Composio
steps.details: In your Composio dashboard, navigate to **Custom Auth Configs**, select **Spotify**, and paste your Spotify app's **Client ID** and **Client Secret**. Supply the required default scopes (`user-read-private`, `user-read-email`, `app-remote-control`, `streaming`, `user-modify-playback-state`, `user-read-playback-state`, `user-read-currently-playing`) and save the configuration to generate your auth config ID.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can use the Composio API with your developer API key to programmatically create and register this custom auth configuration.

requirements.detail: Required to access the dashboard and create an app.
The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account to test playback features in Development Mode.
Up to 5 users must be explicitly added by email in the dashboard user management settings during development.
Mandatory criteria to apply for Extended Quota Mode to support arbitrary users.
Must register https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback in the app settings.

scopes.purpose: Read access to user's subscription details and profile data.
Read access to user's email address.
Control playback of a Spotify user's music and audio streams.
Write access to user playback state (play, pause, skip).
Read access to user's current playback state and active device.

blockers.title: Development Mode User Limit Reached
blockers.symptom: Unallowlisted users receive authentication errors or cannot log in during testing.
blockers.howToProceed: Add the user's email address to the allowlist in the Spotify Developer Dashboard under **Users and Access** (up to 5 users allowed).

blockers.title: Strict 250k MAU Production Eligibility
blockers.symptom: Application for Extended Quota Mode is rejected or blocked because the service is pre-launch or sub-scale.
blockers.howToProceed: Operate within Development Mode with your 5 allowlisted test accounts until your active monthly user metrics cross the 250k threshold.

blockers.title: Missing Spotify Premium on Owner Account
blockers.symptom: Playback commands return permission or feature access errors during testing.
blockers.howToProceed: Upgrade the developer or test user account to a Spotify Premium subscription, as playback endpoints require active premium status.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes
nuances.detail: Spotify access tokens expire after 3,600 seconds (1 hour) and are accompanied by a refresh token.

nuances.title: Refresh Token Expiration
nuances.detail: Refresh tokens expire after 6 months, requiring re-authentication by the end user if not refreshed or managed properly.

nuances.title: PKCE Support
nuances.detail: Spotify supports OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE for enhanced security in client-side or server-side flows.

nuances.title: Strict Redirect URI Matching
nuances.detail: Redirect URIs must match character-for-character with what is registered in the Spotify Developer Dashboard app settings.

steps: Navigate to the Custom Auth section in your Composio dashboard.
Select Spotify as the target toolkit.
Paste your Spotify App Client ID and Client Secret.
Configure the default scopes required for your integration.
Save the configuration and reference the resulting auth config ID in your connection requests.

openQuestions.question: Will Spotify grant exceptions to the 250,000 MAU threshold for specialized AI agent tools?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Indie developers and early-stage AI agent builders cannot meet the 250k MAU requirement, potentially blocking commercial AI integrations.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Monitor Spotify Developer blog announcements and community forums for any policy updates regarding early-stage developer access.
